question: What is the meaning of energy consumption in relation to use and operate phase?
description: During the use phase, information on materials and components can aid facility management (e.g., maintenance) or alteration processes (e.g., transformation). Energy consumption is one of the key aspects monitored in this phase. It is important to track and manage energy use to ensure efficient operation and reduce environmental impacts. This information can also help in planning and optimizing energy efficiency measures for the building.
